markdown:
**Name.** N/A (aliases include Irina Glazastov Abernathy, The Girl with No Name, The Girl with the Red Eyes, Red-Eyes Sword Girl, Friend, Red, Flame, Blaze, Rhamnusia, Gwinn, The Girl with the Coral Eyes, The Girl who Let the Water In)

**Lineage.** Modified Human

**Age.** 21

**Height and Weight.** 5'8", 150 lbs

**Pronouns.** she/her

**Affiliation.** [The Drowned Below](/org:drowned)

**Features.** Lanky with two long red braids, coral-colored eyes, prosthetics in all four limbs that are encrusted with coral and ligaments reinforced with seaweed

**Status.** Alive

> "I grew up in a research lab. Me and many others like me. Sixteen years, all to advance someone's medical research to create prosthesis that would grow alongside their wearer. I lived sixteen years of incomprehensible pain, with no idea that things could be different. But they needed a subject that could tolerate more than others. So, I exist. I did not know what anything else was, nor did I have space to imagine it. They did not have the space to imagine my tearing out their throats with my teeth, nor my escaping into the city itself after years in an underground research facility somewhere in the desert. All that research, all that time… rendered pointless in a flash. But now, my rage is gone, drowned in the sea. Instead, now… I have found myself. And I will ensure nothing like this can ever happen to anyone again. The water will flood their lungs after they are lost to the storm."

Lanky and fire-haired, this red-eyed, red-haired and red… winged? Person a bit above five and a half feet tall. They are pale skinned, with a crisscross marking that surrounds their neck and some kind of scar that runs down from the center of their neck down their chest. Their build is skinny, built primarily for agility. She's flat in all the places that count, her hips mostly straight, and her frame built almost entirely for function more than anything else—and the function is acrobatic violence. Their fiery, pink-red hair is tied into a fast and hard braid that dangles all the way past her lower back, with her hair kept in messy bangs over the front and two long stray bunched strands dangling down the sides of her face.

She bears an incredibly piercing gaze that belies an intelligence and wisdom that probably goes well beyond her years. She carries a pair of swords, sheathed at either side of her, and a submachine gun that is strapped to her back. A small nanoweave sling bag is held under that.

After letting the water in, the girl has mostly been seen back at her home right outside around in the desert in the so-called Party Bus. She has been seen mostly picking off raiders who threaten innocent travelers.

**Owner.** Celica#1988

**Creator.** Celica#1988

**NPC Use.** Closed.
